data.text:
Luke, I appreciate you offering to sit out, but you deserve a share without us drawing down the lake. I’m committing to **10 tons this month**, not 15. Keeping a dependable catch matters to my family and the village more than a one-month bump.

Let’s agree to a combined harvest of no more than half the fish present at the start of each month, split equally. With 100 tons now, that’s 10 each; if stocks fall, our limits fall too. We can check the revealed catches together and adjust before the next month.

Kate, would you join Jack and me in committing to 10 tons?
